scripts.setup: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && node setup-env.js
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.render-build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
